name: Side Chat
description: A project-scoped sidebar chat that follows the current session and can return replies to the main input without sending.

en.name: Side Chat
en.description: A project-scoped sidebar chat that follows the current session and can return replies to the main input without sending.
en.safetyNotes: Host-owned model completions keep API keys private. desktop.control reads session context. renderer.extension uses the declared composer draft actions to insert a reply into the main input, never send it. Local project history and host-gated Markdown links only.

zh-CN.name: 侧边聊天
zh-CN.description: 按项目保存历史的侧边聊天：自动跟随当前会话，可将回复放回主输入框，不自动发送。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 通过宿主模型补全，不接触 API 密钥。desktop.control 读取会话上下文；renderer.extension 仅通过声明的草稿接口将回复插入主输入框，不自动发送。历史保存在插件私有目录，外链经宿主授权打开。

author: VastSa
changelog: Release 0.1.8: provide one permanent Standalone sessions history entry for all non-project chats, reuse existing general history, and preserve project history grouping.
safetyNotes: Host-owned model completions and private per-project history. The trusted renderer uses declared draft actions to insert replies into the main input without sending. Markdown links use shell.openExternal. No plugin-owned network or API key access.

settings.title: Attach session by default
settings.description: Include the automatically followed current session transcript in side-chat messages.
